goal.cs: Vyber své vojáky a poraz více nepřátel, než jich na konci zůstane.
goal.en: Select your soldiers and defeat more enemies than remain at the end.

stages.goal: Create a board with sword and bow soldiers on two teams.
Click a friendly soldier and show which soldier is selected.
Let a selected sword soldier attack a nearby enemy.
Give every soldier three health points and remove defeated enemies.
Add a bow soldier with range four and damage one.
Run a sixty-second battle and add at most five enemies every five seconds.
Stop the battle and announce the result using deadEnemies > livingEnemies.
